note: The spider with its fingers in a new order, with the order written out as frets and fingers, where the run starts, which way it goes and where it turns. The why says what the new order trains.

exercise.title: The spider in a new finger order
exercise.why: In the order 1, 3, 2, 4 each finger has to move while the finger beside it stays down, which is what a phrase needs once it stops going straight up the frets.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the metronome at {{=bpm}}. The tab under it shows frets 5 to 8 in a new order on each string: fret 5, fret 7, fret 6, then fret 8, with fingers 1, 3, 2 and 4, one note per beat.
Start on the low E string and play the four notes on every string up to the high e string. Then come back down, one string at a time, in the same order of fingers. The row under the tab shows the finger for each note.
Practice until the order stops needing thought and every note rings.
